dct_description_sm: This dataset includes raw data and post-processed data resulting from non-photochemical relaxation experiments conducted in the Canadian Arctic Archipelago and Svalbard Archipelago during the summer-fall seasons of 2022. The efficiency of marine photosynthesis is directly affected by NPQ, which releases light energy absorbed by Photosystem II as heat. Increased NPQ reduces the quantum yields of the alternative energy dissipation pathways, i.e. Chlorophyll fluorescence and photochemistry. Researchers using fluorescence-based applications to quantify photochemistry yields need to account for NPQ effects. Through the summer and fall seasons of 2022, NPQ relaxation experiments were conducted in-situ through various Arctic oceanographic regimes to characterize the kinetics and time-scales of NPQ relaxation. Results provide practical guidelines for the development of future field-based fluorescence protocols.
dct_title_s: Fast Repetition Rate Fluorometry-based measurements of non-photochemical quenching in Arctic phytoplankton assemblages
